mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive two-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening aggregate demand, which pressures corporate margins and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where RSAFS falls for 2 consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the industrial production index above 0.5 percent signals stronger supply-side activity, which boosts earnings expectations and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline in periods where INDPRO rises > 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5 percent signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, which raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the housing starts index (HOUST) above 5 percent signals stronger residential investment, which boosts construction-related earnings and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline in periods where HOUST rises > 5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in nonfarm payrolls above 100,000 signals stronger labor market conditions, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline in periods where PAYEMS rises > 100,000 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the consumer price index above 0.4 percent signals accelerating inflation, which prompts tighter monetary policy and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where CPIAUCSL rises > 0.4% (t-test p > 0.05).
